title: Read My Entry
text: Read My Entry. The material is nice quality. It came without a tool that was listed. The lip of the lid needs to be sanded because it has many slivers. At the START of screwing in one of the screws, the material cracked. There was a crack in the bottom almost the whole length of the bench. And there is NO WAY it would support 300 pounds. I would return it but I got it for my closet therefore no one will be sitting on it.

product_metadata.title: Artmalle Bamboo Shoe Rack Bench, 3-Tier Entryway Organizer Shelf with Storage Drawer,Holds Up to 300Lbs for Hallway Bedroom Living Room,27.5"x11"x17.5" (Natural)
